By-design system limit (maximum 200 documents per bulk approval batch)
customer_reply: Hello, thank you for reaching out to Zycus Support. Regarding your inability to bulk approve 500 purchase orders: this behavior is by design. Bulk approval accepts a maximum of 200 documents per batch to protect approval audit trails, which causes the Approve button to be greyed out when more than 200 items are selected. To resolve this, please filter your approval list (for example, by supplier or date) into batches of 200 or fewer and approve each batch sequentially. Please let us know if you need any further assistance.
internal_note: Customer attempted to bulk approve 500 purchase orders at once, resulting in the Approve button being greyed out. Per KB-4859, bulk approval has a strict limit of 200 documents per batch by design. No bug or incident exists; resolved with standard workaround of splitting batches.
